Maya (CSM): Hey team — NorthernGrid renewal is with procurement now. They require separate POs for Hosted API vs Dedicated capacity and need the PO to reference the contract ID. They also asked for net30. Thoughts?

Liam (Account Exec): We usually accept a single PO referencing multiple SKUs but yeah we can do split POs. Need to confirm pricing mapping for the dedicated commit. I'll ping finance.

Jordan (Finance): Split POs are fine. They just need to map to the right SKUs/revenue codes. Please ask procurement to include these lines exactly:

```
RINF-HOST - Hosted API (monthly usage) - qty: 1 - price: $[usage-based]
RINF-DED  - Dedicated Capacity (monthly reserved) - qty: 1 - price: $12,000
Contract ID: RINF-2026-043
```

Sophia (Legal): We need the contract ID on the PO and that the PO references SOW v2. For e-sign, we can do separate envelopes. If pricing/term changes are requested, we'll do a short amendment. Net30 is OK but flag dedicated as non-cancellable for the term.

Maya (CSM): Procurement prefers separate e-signatures for audit reasons — is that fine operationally?

Liam (Account Exec): Yes — two DocuSign envelopes both referencing the same contract ID is fine. That avoids reissuing invoices. :+1:

Jordan (Finance): For billing, ask them to send PO to billing@northernredwood.com and include remit-to info. I'll attach an invoice template.

(escalations-bot): Invoice template uploaded to SF case #CS-4472 by Jordan.

Maya (CSM): Great — I'll send procurement the invoice snippet and request two envelopes. Will update when POs land. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
